## Change

Explain the problem, the resulting behavior, and any related issue.

## Verification

List commands and results. For UI changes, include desktop and narrow-screen checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and the documentation matches its behavior.
- [ ] Checks pass, or limitations are explained above.
- [ ] Examples and evidence contain no secrets, personal data, or operator infrastructure details.
- [ ] New assets/dependencies include their source and applicable license notices.
